function: Near-field channel estimation: deep-unfolded ISTA-GS (DLISTA) jointly learns the polar-domain dictionary and the channel estimate from pilot observations (p. 2-4).
system: Uplink TDD-OFDM XL-MIMO: BS with 256-antenna ULA and 4 RF chains (hybrid), single-antenna users, 30 GHz, 32 pilots, no RIS (p. 2, 4).
method: Deep unfolding (LISTA-GS-based DLISTA), T=15 layers with learnable dictionary, matrix S3 and thresholds; supervised training with Adam on channel labels, loss with row-sparsity term (p. 4-5).
data_channel: Simulated near-field spherical-wave channel (Eq. 4), L=6 paths, gains CN(0,1), distances 5-20 m; 54000 samples: 50000 train, 2000 test, 2000 validation (p. 4-5).
test_conditions: Same simulation setting for training, validation and testing (held-out 2000 samples); SNR swept -5 to 15 dB; training SNR not stated (p. 4-5).
baselines: Learned: LISTA-GS [13], SDL-LISTA [9]; classical: ISTA-GS, P-SOMP [2], LS (p. 5).
metrics: NMSE (dB) versus number of layers or iterations and versus SNR (p. 5).
complexity: Order of complexity per iteration O(SMPN_BS), equal to ISTA-GS, LISTA-GS, SDL-LISTA; orders for P-SOMP and LS also given (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 2: "we adopt the expression of the simplified near-field channel model as follows"; Eq. (4) with L=6 paths, CN(0,1) gains and 5-20 m distances (p. 4) is a custom simulator, and no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 5: "50000 samples are used for network training, 2000 samples are used for testing"; this is a held-out split of one simulated setting plus an SNR sweep (Fig. 3), with no other scenario, array size, pilot number or band tested.
q3_support: p. 5: "DLISTA also outperforms SDL-LISTA" and "outperforms the P-SOMP [2] method by 3 dB at an SNR of 15 dB"; NMSE is also compared with LISTA-GS, ISTA-GS and LS (Figs. 2-3).
q4_support: p. 4: "For each iteration, the computational complexity of DLISTA is" O(SMPN_BS), and the orders of ISTA-GS, LISTA-GS, SDL-LISTA, P-SOMP and LS are also given.
q5_support: p. 5: "The dataset contains a total of 54000 samples"; the data are generated by the authors, and the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Area 2: learned near-field channel estimation by deep unfolding, whose trained parameters are the dictionary, S3 and the thresholds. The system has no RIS (a RIS paper appears only in the references), and the BS has 256 antennas, so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. q2 is 0 because the SNR sweep and the held-out split do not count. Legends of Figs. 2-3 were read from the page image (p. 5).
